notes.title: Small game optimization update is released
notes.content:
This update is targeting mostly people with "slow fps problems".
Some interface dialogues were causing frame drop downs on some PC configurations. 
That's why people were getting 60 fps, when entering "escape menu" and lower "fps" while playing.
I'm hoping this update will fix the issue for some of you.

notes.title: Hungarian language pack plus many new optimizations.
notes.content:
Hey guys,
This update includes a brand new language pack - Hungarian
and many new game optimizations:
- Now interface should be more responsive,
- Some main character animations are re-done and now his moves should look far more better.
- Final boss fight scene is optimized, now The Dragon should change his behaviour and act more accurate to player decisions.
- A numerous small game-play bugs are now fixed.

notes.title: New, cheaper price and new game mode - Battle Arena.
notes.content:
Hey guys, this update introduces new game mode and lower price:

* Brand new game mode: Krum - Battle Arena! 
It's a competitive mode, where you fight against gruesome monsters and climb up in the ladder against other players.Each kill, executed combo and successful block earns you points.
Fight and earn your rightful place on the Wall Of Fame. How far will you go?

* Now Krum - Edge Of Darkness is with new, lower price. Hurry up and join the fight!

* A bunch of gameplay improvements:
	- Maps optimizations.
	- UI optimizations.
	- Combo UI texts updated.
	- LOD system imrovements.
	- Bug connected to performing "long jump" fixed.

notes.title: 3 new weapons, performance optimization and re-balance.
notes.content:
This patch include 3 brand new weapons
- Long sword - two-handed weapon with high damage and a bit low durability.
- Ancient polearm - two-handed weapon with high damage and medium durability.
- Battle axe - one-handed weapon with balanced durability and damage.
- Dagger appearance improved.

Beware - many of the enemies are also equipped with those.

Rebalance
- Hunting bow durability increased.
- Hunting bow arrows damage increased
Now hunting bow is quite effective.

Fixes
- Fixed going trough some walls
- Camera close up bug fixed.
- Ork Priest AI updated

Various performance optimizations.

notes.title: New update fixing issues with Nvidia GTX 7xx series
notes.content:
Hello, what is in this update:

- Now fps drop downs on some(but not all) Nvidia GTX 7xx series should be fixed.
- Now background music stops when battle music is playing.
- Fixed some textures issues in the game HUD.
- Fixed some physics issues.
